title: docs(skills): objectstack-automation names the silent half of the after-save retried-callout rule
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi98UyUjdSwnnoSbQJ4xrcxMC)_
Fixes #33565
domain:skills#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmS31e3TWs9D3DJShfG
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-automation` 技能的 `try_catch` 行补上一句「静默的那一半」:记录保存后触发的流程,经 `subflow` / `map` 子流程走到被重试的内联外呼时,不会被拒绝,而是保存成功却永不挂载触发器;同时把故障边说明里不存在的键 `errorHandling.retry` 改成真实拼写 `errorHandling.strategy: 'retry'`,并追加一条评测用例。
- 为什么改:PR #33482 只教了「保存时被拒绝」的那一半;另一半没有任何报错,AI 作者写出的流程发布成功、改记录却不执行,只能在状态接口看到 `bound: false` / `unboundCause: retried_callout_in_subflow`,技能里此前没有一个字提到它。
- 风险与回滚:只动已发布技能的文字与评测夹具,不动运行时与契约;token 上限行不动(就地删五处重复付账,6857 → 6858,上限 6861)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 的 `try_catch` 行(新增句,风险在措辞是否与引擎一致);② 同文件 Trigger Types 表(删掉 `Fires` 列,是最大的一处删减);③ `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` 第 23 例。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期看到 `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md is 6858 tokens (ceiling 6861; headroom 3)` 且以 ✓ 收尾。
- 需要你做的:无,Tier S,席位在复审 PASS、检查全绿后落地。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, `try_catch` row, directly after the refused half PR #33482 added: "Inside a `subflow` / `map` child, retried by either flow, that is **silent**: the flow saves but never arms (`GET /api/v1/automation/_status`: `bound: false`, `unboundCause: retried_callout_in_subflow`) until the child's `http` is `durable: true` or nothing retries the call."
- Same file, the fault-edge note: "does not consume a flow-level `errorHandling.retry`" now reads "does not consume the flow-level retry (`errorHandling.strategy: 'retry'`)". The schema has no `retry` key under `errorHandling`.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json`: one appended case, id 23 (a `record-after-update` caller whose `subflow` child retries an inline `http`; publishing reports nothing, the flow never runs).
- `.changeset/33565-retried-callout-in-subflow-skill.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.
- Paid in place, no ratchet row moves. Five restatements cut, each with its surviving home:
  1. Trigger Types table, the `Fires` column ("after insert", "before update", …). Home: the `triggerType` token itself and the `ObjectQL hook` column of the same row; "(can modify/reject)" and "one flow, both events" are kept, moved into the first column.
  2. "not a name-keyed map" after "`variables` is an **array**". Home: the array example in the same sentence.
  3. "**Not author-facing** —" on the BPMN-interop row. Home: the same row's "author the container".
  4. "declare `runAs: 'system'` when the elevation is intended" closing the hook note. Home: the note's own heading and first sentence ("A hook elevates itself with `runAs`", "declares its own `runAs: 'system' | 'user' | 'inherit'`").
  5. "an inbound vendor callback is an `api` flow" in § Integrations are declared. Home: the Flow Types `api` row ("Inbound **webhook**"), the signature bullet's "Vendor-signed: `config.signature` replaces it (recipe 4)", and `references/integration-recipes.md` § 4 "Vendor callback — an `api` flow with `secretRef`".

Authoring tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` answers MANDATORY CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER for `skills/**` (clause ①). The card thread is served below that tier, so this diff was authored by an isolated os-dev subagent pinned to CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER on the same branch, as the card delta orders.

## Tests

No package source changes, so there is no package test to run. The eval case is a fixture (measured, not ratcheted); it is self-consistent: both `must_contain` strings appear in its `expected_output`, the `must_not_contain` string does not.

All readings below are on head `f690c706` of `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, merge base `529ed7d93` (`origin/main`).

| Reading | before (`529ed7d93`) | after (`f690c706`) |

## Acceptance notes

The new sentence was checked against the engine on `529ed7d93`, not against the card.

<details><summary>Engine walk: what "retried", "inline" and "through a subflow / map child" mean</summary>

`packages/services/service-automation/src/subflow-retry-guard.ts`, header: "A call is "retried" when anything above it on the call chain re-runs it: the caller's whole-run retry or a retrying `try_catch` around the `subflow` / `map` node, or the child's (or a deeper child's) own whole-run retry or retrying `try_catch`." That is the skill's "retried by either flow".

Only `subflow` and `map` nodes are followed (line 57):

```ts
function calledFlow(node: FlowNodeParsed): string | undefined {
    if (node.type !== 'subflow' && node.type !== 'map') return undefined;
```

Only an after-record-change caller is judged, and the walk carries the retry down the call chain (lines 103-121):

```ts
    const triggerType = afterRecordChangeTrigger(flow);
    if (triggerType === undefined) return undefined;
    ...
    walkRetriedNodes(flow, flowRunRetry(flow), (node, _path, retriedBy) => {
        ...
        const hit = retriedCalloutIn(flows, callKey(name, called), retriedBy, seen, callKey);
```

Inside the child, a hit is an inline outbound node that something retries (lines 82-87):

```ts
    walkRetriedNodes(flow, outerRetry ?? flowRunRetry(flow), (node, _path, retriedBy) => {
        if (found) return;
        const fix = inlineCalloutFix(node);
        if (fix && retriedBy) {
```

"Inline" is `http` without `durable: true`, or `connector_action` (`flow-registration-checks.ts` lines 335-338 hold the two node types; lines 408-413):

```ts
export function inlineCalloutFix(node: FlowNodeParsed): string | undefined {
    const fix = INLINE_CALLOUT_FIX.get(node.type);
    if (!fix) return undefined;
    const durable = node.type === 'http' && (node.config as { durable?: unknown } | undefined)?.durable === true;
    return durable ? undefined : fix;
}
```

`afterRecordChangeTrigger` (same file, line 324) accepts exactly the `record-after-` tokens for create, insert, update, delete and write, which is the row's existing "`record-after-*` flow".

</details>

<details><summary>Where the flow is declined, not refused, and where the cause is set</summary>

`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`, `declineOntoSubflowRetriedCallout` (line 7086), doc comment: "A decline, never a refusal, for the other halves' reasons: the child may register after this flow, so `registerFlow` cannot refuse it without depending on load order. The after-save judge refuses the same shape in the flow's own graph at registration". It records the reason and logs one `warn` ("is registered but NOT armed on trigger"). So "silent" in the skill means no refusal reaches the author; the server log and the status door do carry it.

`packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-definitions.ts` lines 332-333 set the cause:

```ts
    const retryDeclined = this.subflowRetryDeclinedFlows.get(name);
    if (retryDeclined !== undefined) return { reason: retryDeclined, cause: 'retried_callout_in_subflow' };
```

`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts` lines 1044-1051 document it and the remedy: "`retried_callout_in_subflow` — the arming gate declined the flow because it runs after a record change and a `subflow` / `map` node of it reaches a child flow holding an inline outbound call (`http` without `durable: true`, or `connector_action`) that something on the call chain retries … Author remedy: make the child's `http` node durable, or remove the retry, and the flow arms." `bound` (line 967) and `unboundCause` (line 1015) are the `FlowRuntimeState` keys the status door serves; `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` line 2524 spells the door `GET /api/v1/automation/_status`, and lines 1275-1281 teach the same rule in the docs.

</details>

<details><summary>The `errorHandling` spelling</summary>

`packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts` line 1353 declares `errorHandling` as a strict object; its retry switch is `strategy` (line 1401, enum `fail` / `retry` / `continue`), with `maxRetries` read only under `strategy: 'retry'`, which requires at least 1 (lines 1428, 1442). There is no `retry` key. The engine reads exactly that (`flow-registration-checks.ts` line 361):

```ts
    const flowRetry = flow.errorHandling?.strategy === 'retry' ? flow.errorHandling.maxRetries : 0;
```

`grep -rn 'errorHandling.retry' skills/` on the head: zero hits (one on `529ed7d93`, the corrected line).

</details>

Notes, not filed:

- The remedy in the new sentence names the child's `http` node and "nothing retries the call"; for a `connector_action` the second half is the only remedy, and the row for that node already says so ("drop the retry, or run the flow on demand / on a schedule").
- The priced file keeps 3 tokens of headroom. `maxRetries` was left out of the corrected spelling to stay under the ceiling; the `try_catch` row spells the switch the same way.

```

The workspace was then built under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, 119 of 119 tasks) and each re-ran to exit 0; the recorded codes are the re-runs.

Outside the derivation, also run, both exit 0: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` ("346 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)").

Token ratchet verdict line: `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md is 6858 tokens (ceiling 6861; headroom 3).`

</details>
